title: Repair post-push CI: release script lint globals and hermetic PARTIAL acceptance env

spec.problem: Push CI for 9efc6a64 failed: the frontend lint ratchet rejects 4 no-undef errors in scripts/release/browser-release.mjs, and the lifecycle job's harness self-test fails because job-level QUALITY_ACCEPT_PARTIAL=true leaks into the self-test and makes a PARTIAL task merge when the test expects refusal.

acceptance.text: scripts/release/*.mjs lint with zero errors under the repository ESLint configuration.
The CI workflow parses and exposes QUALITY_ACCEPT_PARTIAL only on the Lifecycle check step, never at job level, so the harness self-test is hermetic.

spec.expected_behavior: CI on main is green: release scripts lint clean with declared globals and QUALITY_ACCEPT_PARTIAL is visible only to the lifecycle check step.
spec.observed_behavior: checks: RATCHET_VIOLATION new lint no-undef x4; lifecycle: adversarial 'a PARTIAL task needs explicit acceptance to merge' expected 1 got 0.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the single follow-up commit; no data or deployment state is touched because CI failure prevented any deployment.
